caption: The drawing depicts a tall, upright metal stand with three curved legs at the base, supporting a slender vertical pole. At the top of the pole, there is a horizontal support with two holders, each containing a partially-burned candle. Both candles are thin and uneven, with one candle slightly shorter and appearing to have a more melted, irregular tip. The metal structure is rendered in gray graphite or pencil on an off-white, aged background, which is marked with small brownish spots and some scattered stains. The only objects present are the metal stand and the two candles, both centrally placed and occupying the majority of the vertical space in the composition. The background is otherwise blank with no additional elements or setting details. In the bottom right corner, there is faint text that reads "H.N. LUMBARD."
title: Adjustable Candle Holder
